cards.title: Opening
cards.applicability: Choosing the initial commander, reconnaissance, battles, income and construction.

cards.title: Development
cards.applicability: Balancing income payback, construction chains, weekly growth, army production and delivery.

cards.title: Offensive operation
cards.applicability: Choosing a next objective, routes, losses, reinforcement and follow-up.

cards.title: Main army idle
cards.applicability: Distinguishing intentional defense from blocked routes, execution and unsupported goals.

cards.title: Recovery
cards.applicability: Preserving a viable army after losses; commander, mana recovery, delivery and next operation.

cards.title: Defense
cards.applicability: Reassessing town exposure, insufficient defenders or unbounded opposition; valuable bases and multiple fronts.

cards.title: Town after capture
cards.applicability: After capture/completed hold: departure, garrison preparation, interception, renewed defense or changed exposure.

cards.title: Exploration
cards.applicability: Choosing viewpoints, sites and passages; end-turn scouting exposure and reassessment after scout loss.

cards.title: Finish the game
cards.applicability: Choosing a concrete elimination operation, decisive attack or town denial instead of recurring local gains.
